name: Phase-to-phase voltmeter selector
summary: This representation identifies selection among phase-to-phase voltage measurement connections.
description: This representation identifies selection among phase-to-phase voltage measurement connections. The selector connects the meter to the documented line-to-line measurement pairs at its operating positions. It is a measurement interface, not the power switching device of the three-phase circuit.
Provide the actual contact programme and measurement position labels. Identify any instrument-transformer secondary circuits that feed the selector.
readingNotes: Document the selector position table and the meter connection.
A measurement selector must not be mistaken for a three-phase power isolator.
